verified_facts: HMLR polygon data is captured against British National Grid
GML may need conversion for other GIS tools
reprojection to web-map projections is possible
projection conversion calculations can introduce error
BNG to WGS84 conversion may shift some features by up to 15 metres
native BNG should therefore be retained for parcel/elevation binding
coordinate transforms must be recorded rather than silently applied
quality_effect: Keeps HMLR geometry in native BNG for measurement and exposes reprojection error explicitly.
